text: Par laimi, ar mani nikas nanūtyka, bet es redzieju drausmeigu ainu, kai cylvāki raudzeja izsist lūgus, kab tyktu uorā.
eng_text: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Cylvāki ar krāslim syta pa panelim, bet lūgi beja naizsytami.
eng_text: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: "Vīns nu paneļu beidzūt sapleisa, i jī suoce kuopt uorā pa lūgu," saceja izdzeivojušais Francišeks Kovals.
eng_text: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Zvaigznis izdola gaismu i syltumu energejis deļ, kas rūnās, kod iudiņraža atomus sapludynoj, veidojūt smoguokus elementus.
eng_text: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Zynuotnīki struodoj, lai izveiduotu reaktoru, kas var ražuot energeju taidā pošā veidā.
eng_text: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Tok itū problemu ir cīši gryuts atrysynuot, byus vajadzeigi daudzi godi, cikom mes redzēsim, kai tiks calti nūdereigi kūdulsiņtezis reaktori.
eng_text: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Dzeļža odota peļd pa viersu iudiņam viersmys spraiguma deļ.
eng_text: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Viersmys spraigums rūnās deļtam, ka iudiņa molekulys iudiņa vierspusē teik pīsaisteitys vīna ūtrai vairuok nakai viers tūs asūšajom gaisa molekulom.
eng_text: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Iudiņa molekulys veidoj naradzamu plēvi iz iudiņa viersys, kas ļaun taidom lītom kai odota peļdēt pa viersu iduiņam.
eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Modernuos slidys asmiņam ir dubulta mola ar īlīktu dūbi storp tom. Obys molys ļaun lobuok sagiun ladu, pat tod, ka tys ir sasvārts.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Tai kai asmiņa apakšejuo daļa ir nadaudz izlīkta, asmiņam sasasverūt iz vīnu voi ūtru pusi, ari mola, kas sasaskar ar ladu, izalīc.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Tys līk sliduotuojam pasagrīzt. Ka slidys sasasver pa labi, sliduotuojs grīžās pa labi, ka slidys sasasver pa kreisi, sliduotuojs grīžās pa kreisi.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Lai atsagrīztu sovā īprīškejā energejis leiminī, jim vajag atsabreivuot nu papyldu energejis, kū jī sajēme nu gaismys.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Jī tū dora, izstorojūt nīceigu gaismys daleņu, kū sauc par "fotonu".
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Zynuotnīki itū procesu sauc par "stimulātu storuojuma emiseju", deļtam ka atomus stimulej spylgta gaisma, izraisūt gaismys fotona emiseju, i gaisma ir storuojuma veids.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Nuokušajā biļdē ir radzami atomi, kas izstaroj fotonus. Prūtams, patīseibā fotoni ir daudz mozuoki nakai attālā radzamī.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Fotoni ir pat mozuoki nakai vīlys, kas veidoj atomus!
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Piec symtim darbeibys stuņžu kvāldīgs spuļdzē golu golā izdag, i spuļdze vaira nastruodoj.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Piec tuo spuļdze ir juosamaina. Nūmainūt spuļdzi, ir juobyut viereigam.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Pyrmom kuortom, ir juoatslādz gaismys kermiņa sliedzs voi juoatvīnoj kabeļs.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Tys ir deļtam, ka elektreiba, kas īplyust kontaktlygzdā, kur atsarūn spuļdzis metaliskuo daļa, var izraiseit smogu elektriskuos strāvys trīcīni, ka dasadūrsit lygzdys īkšīnei voi spuļdzis metala pamatnei, cikom tei vys vēļ daļeji atsarūn lygzdā.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Golvonais ašņaritis organs ir sirds, kas syuknej ašni.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Ašnis izīt nu sirds ašņavodūs, kurus sauc par arterejom, i atsagrīž sirdī pa ašņavodim, kurus sauc par venom. Mozuokūs ašņavodus sauc par kapilarim.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Triceratopa zūbi byutu variejuši sasmalcynuot na tikai lopys, bet ari pat cīši cītus zorus i saknis.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Daži zynuotnīki dūmoj, ka triceratopi ēde cikadis, kas ir augu veids, kas beja izplateits kreita periodā.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Itī augi izaver kai moza palma ar osu, dzieleigu lopu vainagu.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Triceratops varēja izmontuot sovu spieceigū kņuobi, lai nūteireitu lopys pyrma stumbra apiesšonys
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Cyti zynuotnīki apgolvoj, ka itī augi ir cīši iņdeigi, deļtam ir moz tycams, ka kaids dinozaurs jūs ēde, koč i myusu dīnuos sliņkis i cyti dzeivnīki, pīmāram, papagaiļs (dinozauru piectecs), var ēst iņdeigys lopys voi augļus.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Kai Jo gravitaceja mani pīvylktu? Ka jius stuovātu iz Jo viersys, jius svārtu mozuok nakai iz Zemis.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Cylvāks, kurš iz Zemis sver 200 muorceņu (90 kg), iz Jo sver apmāram 36 muorcenis (16 kg). Deļtam gravitaceja, prūtams, jius pīvalk mozuok.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Saulei nav taidys gorūzys kai Zemei, iz kurys varātu stuovēt. Vysa Saule sastuov nu gazu, guņs i plazmys.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Gaze palīk pluonuoka, vierzejūtīs tuoļuok nu Saulis centra.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Uorejū daļu, kū mes varim redzēt, verūtīs iz Sauli, sauc par fotosferu, kas nūzeimoj "gaismys bumba".
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Apmāram treis tyukstūšys godu vāluok, 1610. godā, itaļu astronoms Galileo Galilejs ar teleskopu nūvāruoja, ka Venerai ir fazis, taipat kai Mienešam.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Fazis nūteik, deļtam ka ir apgaismuota tikai tei Venerys (voi Mieneša) puse, kas ir pagrīzta pret Sauli. Venerys fazis atbaļsteja Kopernika teoreju, ka planetys riņčoj ap Sauli.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Piec tuo dažus godus vāluok, 1639. godā, angļu astronoms vuordā Džeremaija Horoks nūvāruoja Venerys tranzitu.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Anglejā  piec Danelavys atgiušonys beja ilgs mīra periods.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Tok 991. godā Etelredam beja juosasaskar ar vikingu floti, kas beja leluokuo nu Gutruma laika pyrma vīna godu symta.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Itū floti vadeja Olafs Trigvasons, norvegs, kas gribēja atbreivuot sovu vaļsti nu dāņu jiuga.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Piec suokūtnejūs militarūs naveiksmu Etelreds varēja vīnuotīs ar Olafu, kurais atsagrīze Norvegejā, lai raudzeitu īgiut sovu karalisti ar daleitim panuokumim.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul ir vīneigais apzynuoti izgudruotais alfabets popularā kasdīnys lītuošonā. Alfabets tyka izgudruots 1444. goda karaļa Sedžonga (1418–1450) vaļdeišonys laikā.
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Karaļs Sedžongs beja catūrtais Džosonu dinastejis karaļs i vīns nu vysaugstuok nūvārtātuokajim.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Jis suokūtneji nūsauce Hangeul alfabetu Hunmin Jeongeum, kas nūzeimoj "pareizuos skanis tautys nūruodejumim".
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Ir daudz teoreju par tū, kai pasaruodeja sanskrits. Vīna nu tūs ir par ārīšu migraceju nu rītumim iz Indeju, kas atnese sev leidza sovu volūdu.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskrits ir seneja volūda, i tei ir saleidzynoma ar Eiropā lītuotū laiīņu volūdu.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Agruokuo zynamuo gruomota iz pasauļa tyka pīraksteita sanskritā. Piec Upanišadu apkūpuošonys sanskrits vīnkuorši pagaisa hīrarhejis deļ.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskrits ir cīši sarežgeita i boguota volūda, kas ir kolpuojuse par olūtu daudzom myusu dīnu Indejis volūdom, taipat kai laiīņu volūda ir Eiropys volūdu, pīmāram, franču i spāņu, olūts.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Kod ceiņa par Franceju beja beigusēs, Vuoceja suoce gataveitīs ībrukumam Lelbritanejis solā.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Vuoceja uzbrukumu nūsauce par "Operation Sealion". Leluokuo daļa britu armejis smogūs īrūču i kruojumu beja zaudāti, kod tei tyka evakuāta nu Dankerkys, deļtam armeja beja dīzgon vuoja.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Tok Karaliskuo flote vys vēļ beja daudz spieceiguoka par Vuocejis floti ("Kriegsmarine") i varēja iznycynuot sevkuru ībrukuma floti, kas tyka nūsyuteita puori Lamanša šaurumam.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Tok cīši moz Karaliskuos flotis kuģu atsaroda natuoli nu varamūs ībrukuma maršrutu, deļtam ka admirali nūsabeja, ka tūs nūgremdēs vuocu gaisa uzbrukums.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Suoksim ar skaidruojumu par Italejis plānim. Italeja golvonūkuort beja Vuocejis i Japanys "mozais bruoļs".
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Tai beja vuojuoka armeja i vuojuoka flote, koč i jī tikū pyrma kara suokuma beja izbyuviejuši četrus jaunus kuģus.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Italejis golvonī mierki beja Afrikys vaļsts. Lai ījimui ituos vaļsts, tom byutu juobyut karaspāka palaisšonys platformai, lai karaspāks varātu kuģuot puori Vydsjiurai i ībrukt Afrikā.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Partū jim beja juoatsabreivoj nu britu bazem i kugim Egiptē. Bez itūs darbeibu Italejis kaujis kugim nabeja juodora nikas cyts.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Niu par Japanu. Japana beja solu vaļsts, taipat kai Lelbritaneja.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Zamiudinis ir kugi, kas paradzāti ceļuošonai zam iudiņa i palīk tī ilgu laiku.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Zamiudinis tyka izmontuotys Pyrmajā i Ūtrajā pasauļa karā. Tūreiz tuos beja cīši lānys i ar cīši īrūbežuotu saušonys diapazonu.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Kara suokumā tuos puorsvorā ceļuoja pa jiuru, bet, kod radars suoce atsateisteit i palyka precizuoks, zamiudinis beja spīstys dūtīs zam iudiņa, lai natyktu pamaneitys.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Vuocu zamiudinis sauce par U kugim. Vuocīši cīši labi spēja navigēt i vadeit sovys zamiudinis.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Tai kai jim beja panuokumi ar zamiudinem, piec kara vuocīšim nav atļauts turēt daudzys nu tūs.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Nui! Karaļs Tutanhamons, cytu reizi saukts par "Karali Tutu" voi "Karali puiku",  ir vīns nu myusu dīnuos pazeistamuokūs senejuos Egiptis karaļu.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Interesanti, ka senatnē jis natyka skaiteits par cīši nūzeimeigu i nabeja īraksteits leluokajā daļā senejūs karaļu sarokstu.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Tok juo kopa atkluošona 1922. godā padareja jū par slovaneibu. Cikom daudzys paguotnis kapenis beja izzogtys, itys kops palyka praktiski naskorts.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Leluokuo daļa prīškmatu, kas aprokti kūpā ar Tutanhamonu, ir labi sasaglobuojuši, tymā skaitā ari tyukstūšim artefaktu, kas izgataveiti nu duorgmetalu i ratūs akmiņu.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Spīču ritiņa izgudruojums padareja asīrīšu rotus vīgļuokus, mudruokus i lobuok sagataveitus, lai apsteigtu karaveirus i cytus rotus.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Bultys nu jūs nuovejūšūs arbaletu varēja īkliut pretinīku karaveiru bruņuos. Apmāram 1000 godus p.m.e. asīrīši īvīse pyrmū kavalereju.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Kavalereja ir armeja, kas ceinuos iz zyrgy mugorom. Sagli vēļ nabeja izguoduoti, deļtam asīrīšu kavalereja ceinejuos iz plykom zyrgu mugorom.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Mes zinim daudzus Grīkejis politiķus, zynuotnīkus i muokslinīkus. Varams, ituos kulturys pazeistamuokuo persona ir Homers, legendarais oklais dzejnīks, kurs saceriejs divus grīķu literaturys šedevrus: eposus Iliada i Odiseja.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sofokls i Aristofans vys vēļ ir populari dramaturgi, i jūs lugys teik skaiteitys par vīnim nu izcyluokūs pasauļa literaturys dorbu.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Vēļ vīns slovons grīkis ir matematikis Pitagors, kurs golvonūkuort ir pazeistams ar sovu slovanū teoremu par tainsleņķa treisstyura molu attīceibom.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Ir vysaidi apriekini par tū, cik cylvāku runoj hindi volūdā. Teik skaiteits, ka tei ir nu ūtruos leidz catūrtajai vysbīžuok lītuotajai volūdai iz pasauļa.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Dzymtuos volūdys runuotuoju skaits mainuos atkareibā nu tuo, voi teik skaiteiti cīši saisteiti dialekti.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Apliesis svuorstuos nu 340 miļjonim leidz 500 miļjonim runuotuoju, i pat 800 miļjoni cylvāku var saprast volūdu.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi i urdu volūdys vuordu kruojums ir leidzeigs, bet raksteiba atsaškir; kasdīnys sarunuos obu volūdu runuotuoji parosti var vīns ūtru saprast.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Apmāram 15. godu symtā Igaunejis zīmeli beja lelā Vuocejis kulturys ītekmē.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Daži vuocu mūki gribēja tyvynuot Dīvu vītejim cylvākim, deļtam tī izgudruoja igauņu rokstu volūdu.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Tei beja baļsteita iz vuocu alfabetu, i tyka davīnuota vīna rakstzeime "Õ/õ".
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Laikam īmūt, saplyude daudzi vuordi, kas tyka pajimti nu vuocu volūdys. Tys beja apgaismeibys suokums.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Tradicionali trūņmaņtinīks piec školys beigšonys izreiz devēs iz militarū dīnastu.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Tok Čārlzs īsastuoja universitatē Kembridžys Treisvīneibys koledžā, kur studēja antropologeju i arheologeju i vāluok viesturi, sajamūt 2:2 (zamuoku ūtruos klasis grādu).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Čārlzs beja pyrmais Lelbritanejis karaliskuos saimis lūceklis, kuram tyka pīškierts grāds.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Eiropys Turceja (austrumu Trakeja aba Rumeleja Balkanu pussolā) īkļaun 3% vaļsts.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Turcejis teritoreja ir vaira nakai 1600  kilometru (1000 jiudžu) gara i 800 km (500 jiudžu) plota, i tai ir apmāram taisnstyura forma.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Turcejis plateiba, īskaitūt azarus, aizjam 783 562 kvadratkilometrus (300 948 kvadratjiudzis), nu kurūs 755 688 kvadratkilometri (291 773 kvadratjiudzis) atsarūn Āzejis dīnvydrītumūs i 23 764 kvadratkilometri (9174 kvadratjiudzis) Eiropā.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Turcejis plateiba padora tū par 37. leluokū vaļsti iz pasauļa, i tei ir apmāram Francejis Metropolis i Apvīnuotuos Karalistis lelumā.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turceju īkļaun jiurys nu treis pušu: Egejis jiura rītumūs, Malnuo jiura zīmeļūs i Vydsjiura dīnvydūs.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luksemburgai ir sena viesture, tok tuos naatkareiba aizasuoce 1839. godā.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Myusu dīnu Beļgejis dalis agruok beja daļa nu Luksemburgys, tok piec Beļgejis Revoļucejis 1830. godūs palyka par Beļgejis daļom.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luksemburga vysod ceņtēs palikt par neitralu vaļsti, tok tyka okupēta nu Vuocejis pusis gon I Pasauļa karā, gon II Pasauļa karā.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: 1957. godā Luksemburga kliva par dybynuotuoju organizacejai, kuru myusu dīnuos pazeistom kai Eiropys Savīneibu.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: "Drukgyal Dzong" ir izpūsteits cītūksnis i Budistu klūsters Paro rajona augšejā daļā (Phondeja cīmatā).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Ir saceits, ka 1649. godā  Zhabdrungs Ngavangs Namgjes izveiduoja cītūksni, kab pīmynātu sovu uzvaru puor tibetīšu-mongoļu spākim.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: 1951. goda guņsgrāka rezuļtatā palyka viņ dažys "Drukgyal Dzong" relikvejis, pīmāram, Zhabdrunga Ngavanga Namgja attāls.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Piec guņsgrāka cītūksnis tyka saglobuots i aizsorguots, kliustūt par vīnu nu Butanys sensacionaluokuom atrakcejom.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: 18. godu symta laikā Kambodža beja īspīsta storp divim spieceigim sābrim – Taivanu i Vjetnamu.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Taizemīši 18. godu symtā vairuokys reizis ībruka Kambodžā, i 1772. godā jī iznycynuoja Pnompeņu.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: 18. godu symta pādejūs godūs vjetnamīši ari ībruka Kambodžā.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Ostoņpadsmit procentu venecuelīšu ir bezdarbnīki i struodoj ānu ekonomikā.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Divys trešdalis venecuelīšu struodoj pakolpuojumu sektorā, gondreiž catūrtdaļa struodoj ryupnīceibā i pīktdaļa – lauksaimnīceibā.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Svareiga industreja deļ venecuelīšu ir nafta, kur vaļsts ir neto eksportātuoja, koč ari tikai vīns procents struodoj naftys ryupnīceibā.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Vaļsts naatkareibys suokumā Singapurys Botaniskuo duorza zynuošonys paleidzēja puorveiduot solu par tropiskū duorzu piļsātu.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: 1981. godā par tautys nacionalū zīdu tyka izvālāts orhideju hibrids "Vanda Miss Joaquim".
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Kotru godu ap oktobri leita deļ apmāram 1,5 miļjoni zuolāduoju, škārsojūt Mara upi, nu zīmeļu pakolnim dūdās iz dīnvydu leidzonumim.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: I tod atpakaļ aprelī piec leitim iz zīmelim cauri rītumim, vēļreiz škārsojūt Mara upi.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Serengeti regionā ir Serengeti Nacionalais parks, Ngorongoro Aizsorguojamuo teritoreja i Masvys Medejumu rezervats Tanzanejā i Masai Mara Nacionalais rezervats Kenejā.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Kab īsavuiceitu veiduot interaktivus medejus, ir napīcīšamys pījimtys i tradicionalys prasmis, kai ari interaktivuos nūdarbeibuos apgiuti reiki (ilustracejis, audio i video redigiešona, stuostu stuosteišona i c.).
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Interaktivam dizainam ir napīcīšams atkuortuoti nūviertēt sovus pījāmumus par medeju produciešonu i vuiceitīs dūmuot nalinearūs veidūs.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Interaktivais dizains prosa, kab projekta komponenti byutu savīnuoti vīns ar ūtru, tok kab tim byutu jāga ari kai atseviškom vīneibom.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Tuoluma mainis objektivu tryukums ir taids, ka fokusa sarežgeiteiba i objektivu elementu skaits, kas napīcīšams, kab sasnāgtu fokusa attuoluma diapazonu, ir daudz leluoks nakai pamata objektivam.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Tys palīk mozuok aktuali, partū ka objektivu ražuotuoji sasnādz augstuokus standartus objektivu ražuošonā.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Tys ir ļuovs tuoluma mainis objektivim radeit attālus, kuru kvalitate ir saleidzynoma ar objektivim ar fiksātū fokusa attuolumu.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Vēļ vīns tuoluma mainis objektivu tryukums ir tys, ka objektiva maksimaluo diafragma (uotrums) parosti ir mozuoks.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Tys padora lātus tuoluma mainis objektivus gryuši lītuojamus vuoja apgaismuojuma apstuokļūs bez zibspuļdzis.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Vīna nu vysbīžuokūs problemu video puorveiduošonā DVD formatā ir puorskeniešona.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Leluokuo daļa televizejis puorraižu ir veidotys tai, kab apmīrynuotu leluokū sabīdreibys daļu.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Deļtam vysam, kū redzit televizejā, beja apmale, augšdaļa, apakšmola i suonu molys.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Tys teik dareits, kab nūdrūsynuotu, ka attāls nūsadz vysu ekranu. Tū sauc par puorskeniešonu.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Dīvamžāļ, veidojūt DVD failu, tuo apmalis, vysdreizuok, arī tiks nūgrīztys i, ka video subtitri ir puoruok tyvai apakšai, tī natiks piļneibā paruodeiti.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Tradicionaluo vydslaiku piļs jau ilgu laiku atdzeivynoj iztieli, uzburūt biļdis ar turnirim, banketim i Arturīšu bruņnīceibu.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Pat stuovūt storp tyukstūša godu vacom drupom ir vīglai izatāluot seņ pazudušuos kauju skanis i smaržys, gondreiž sadzierdēt dzeivnīku nogu klabiešonu pa bruģakmini i saūst bailis, kas pasaceļ nu cītumu dziļumim.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: A voi myusu izdūma ir baļsteita realitatē? Parkū piļis vyspuor tyka caltys ? Kai tuos beja projektātys i caltys?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Rakstureigi itam laikam "Kirby Muxluo" piļs vairuok ir nūcītynuota sāta, navys eista piļs.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Tuo lelī stykluotī lūgi i pluonuos sīnys nabyutu spiejušys ilgai pretuotīs apjiemeigam uzbrukumam.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: 15. gs. 80. godūs, kod lords Heistings suoce tuos ceļtnīceibu, vaļsts beja samārā mīreiga i aizsardzeiba beja napīcīšama tikai pret nalelom marodīru grupom.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Spāku samārs beja sistema, kurā Eiropys nacejis raudzeja saglobuot vysu Eiropys vaļstu nacionalū suverenitati.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Koncepceja beja taida, ka vysom Eiropys vaļstim beja juorauga nūvērst tū, ka vīna naceja palīk spieceiguoka, deļtam vaļstu vaļdeibys bīži  maineja sovys aliansis, kab saglobuotu leidzsvoru.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Spānejis montuojuma kars īzeimēja pyrmū karu, kura golvonais vaicuojums beja spāku leidzsvors.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Tys īzeimuoja svareigys puormainis, it kai Eiropys varom vaira nabyutu īganstu karus saukt par religiskajim karim. Deļtam Treisdesmit godu kars byutu pādejais kars, kas tyktu nūsaukts par religiskū karu.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Artemidys templis Efezā tyka iznycynuots 356. goda p.m.e. 21. julī Herostrata izdareitā dadzynuošonys aktā.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Saskaņā ar stuostu juo motivaceja beja slave par kotru cenu. Efezīši sašutuši paziņuoja, ka Herostrata vuords nikod natiks saglobuots.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Greku viesturnīks Strabons vāluok atzeimuoja vuordu, kuru mes zinim šudiņ. Templis tyka iznycynuots tamā pošā naktī, kod pīdzyma Aleksandrs Lelais.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Aleksandrs kai karaļs pīduovuoja samoksuot par tempļa atjaunuošonu, tok juo pīduovuojums tyka nūraideits. Vāluok, piec Aleksandra nuoves, templis tyka puorbyuvāts 323. godā p.m.e.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Rūka juobyut piec īspiejis atbreivuotuokai, vīnlaikus pareizi mīdzūt vysys notys, taipat juorauga naizdareit līkys kusteibys ar pierstim.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Taidā veidā jius sevi nūgurdynuosit piec īspiejis mozuok. Atguodojit – lai dabuotu leluoku skaļumu, pīmāram, klavīrem, nav napīcīšams mīgt tausteņus ar leluoku spāku.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Akordeonam, kab dabuotu leluoku skaļumu, juoizmontoj pliešys ar leluoku spīdīni voi skaļumu.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Misticisms ir tīkšonuos piec kūpeibys ar identitati, ar apzynuoteibys izpratni par galejū realitati, dīviškeibu, gareigu patīseibu voi Dīvu.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Ticeigais meklej tīšu pīredzi, intuiceju voi īskotu dīviškajā realitatē/dīveibā voi dīveibuos.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Sekuotuoji izmontoj konkretus dzeivis veidus voi praksis, kas ir paredzātys ituos pīredzis veicynuošonai.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Luksemburgai ir seneja viesture, tok tuos naatkareiba suocēs 1839. godā.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikhisms ir Indejis subkontinenta religeja. Tys roduos Pendžabys regionā 15. godu symtā hinduistu tradicejis škeļšonuos rezultatā.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Sikhi sovu ticeibu skaita par atsevišķu religeju nu hinduisma, koč i jī pīzeist tuos hinduisma saknis i tradicejis.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Sikhi sovu religeju sauc par Gurmat, kas pandžabu volūdā nūzeimoj "guru ceļš". Guru ir vysu Indejis religeju pamatspāks, tok sikhismā ir īgivs svareigu nūzeimi, kas veidoj sikhu uzskotu pamatu.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Religeji 15. godu symtā nūdybynuoja Guru Nanaks (1469-1539). Piec juo sekuoja vēļ deveni guru.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Tok 1956. goda junī Hruščova sūlejumi tyka puorbaudeiti, kod namīri Pūlejā, kur struodnīki protestēja pret puortykys tryukumu i olgu samazynuošonu, puorauga vyspuorejā protestā pret komunismu.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Koč i golu golā Hruščovs syuteja tankus, lai atjaunuotu kuorteibu, jis tūmār pīsakuope dažom ekonomiskajom praseibom i pīkryta par jaunū premjerministru īceļt popularū Vladislavu Gomulku.
eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Indys īlejis civilizaceja beja bronzys laikmata civilizaceja Indejis zīmeļrītumu subkontinentā, kas īkļuove leluokū daļu myusu dīnu Pakistanys i dažus regionus Indejis zīmeļrītumūs i Afganistanys zīmeļaustrumūs.
eng_text: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Civilizaceja uzplauka Indys upis baseinā, deļtam tei dabuoja sovu nūsaukumu.
eng_text: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Koč i daži zynuotnīki skaita – tai kai civilizaceja pastuovēja ari tagad izkoltušuos Sarasvati upis baseinā, tei byutu truopeigi saukta par Indys-Sarasvati civilizaceju, tok daži tū sauc par Harapys civilizaceju piec Harapys, kas ir pyrmuo nu tuos vītom, kas tyka izrokta 20. gs. 20. godūs.
eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Rūmys imperejis militarais raksturs veicynuoja medicinys sasnāgumu atteisteibu.
eng_text: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Uorstus suoce olguot imperators Augusts i pat izveiduoja pyrmū rūmīšu medicinys korpusu, kū izmontuoja kauju saku likvidiešonai.
eng_text: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Kirurgim beja zynuošonys par vysaidim nūmīrynūšajim leidzeklim, tymā skaitā morfiju nu mogonu sāklu ekstraktu i skopolaminu nu zuolaugu sāklu.
eng_text: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Jī īsavuiceja amputacejis prasmis, lai gluobtu pacientus nu gangrenys, kai ari zynuoja, kai lītuot žņaugus i arterialuos skovys, lai apturātu ašņa plyusmu.
eng_text: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Vairuoku godu symtu laikā Rūmys impereja ir davuse lelus īgivumus medicinys jūmā i veiduojuse lelu daļu zynuošonu, kū mes zinim niu.
eng_text: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Pureland origami ir origami ar īrūbežuojumu, ka vīnlaiceigi var veikt tikai vīnu lūcejumu, nav atļauti sarežgeituoki lūcejumi, pīmāram, reversī lūcejumi, i vysim lūcejumim ir vīnkuorša vīta, kur jis atsarūn.
eng_text: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Tū izstruoduoja Džons Smits 20. gs. 70. godūs, lai paleidzātu napīredziejušim lūceituojim voi tim, kam ir īrūbežuotys motorikys prasmis.
eng_text: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Bārni apsazynoj rasi i rasu stereotipus dīzgon mozā vacumā, i itī rasu stereotipi ītekmej uzvedeibu.
eng_text: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Par pīmāru, bārni, kuri identificejās ar rasu minoritati, par kuru pastuov stereotips, ka taidim školā nasaveic labi, uzzynojūt par stereotipim, kas saisteiti ar jūs rasi, narauga sasnēgt lobus ruodeituojus.
eng_text: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace ir trešais popularuokais interneta portals Amerikys Savīnuotajuos Vaļstīs, niu tymā ir 54 miļjoni lītuotuoju.
eng_text: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Ituos vītnis ir pīsaistejušys miļzeigu viereibu, seviški izgleiteibys jūmā.
eng_text: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Itom sātyslopom ir pozitivi aspekti, kas īkļaun īspieju ārtai izveiduot klasis lopu, kurā var īkļaut emuarus, videoklipus, fotoattālus i kur ir ari cytys īspiejis.
eng_text: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Itai sātyslopai var vīgli tikt kluot, nūruodūt tikai vīnu interneta adresi, kas ļaun tū vīgli atguoduot i uzraksteit studentim, kurim, varams, ir problemys ar tastaturys lītuošonu ci pareizraksteibu.
eng_text: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Tū var pīlāguot vīglai laseišonai i ar tik daudz voi moz kruosu, cik vālams.
eng_text: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Uzmaneibys deficita trauciejumi "ir neirologisks sindroms, kura klasiskuo simptomu triade īkļaun impulsivitati, izklaideibu i hiperkativitati voi puormiereigu energeju".

eng_text: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

eng_text: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Laiks ir myusim vysapleik i ītekmej vysu, kū mes dorom, vystik tū ir gryuši saprast.
eng_text: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Laiku jau tyukstūšym godu ir pietejuši religejis, filozofejis i zynuotnis pazinieji.
eng_text: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Mes pīdzeivojom laiku kai nūtykumu virteni, kas puorīt nu nuokūtnis caur tagadni iz poguotni.
eng_text: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Laiks ir ari veids, kai mes saleidzynojom pasuocīņu garumu (ilgumu).
eng_text: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Jius pats varot atzeimēt laika ritejumu, nūvārojūt kaida cikliska nūtykuma atsakuortuošonu. Ciklisks nūtykums ir koč kas taids, kas regulari nūteik otkon i otkon.
eng_text: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Myusu dīnuos datorus izmontoj, kab apstruoduot attālus i videoklipus.
eng_text: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

eng_text: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Muzyka bīži teik īraksteita izmontojūt sarežgeitus datorus, kab apstruoduot i miksēt kūpā skanis.
eng_text: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

eng_text: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

eng_text: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Vystik jauni pīruodejumi līcynoj, ka moriori beja kontinentalūs maori grupa, kas migrēja nu Jaunzelandis iz Četemu solom, atteistūt sovu atškireigū, mīreigū kuļturu.
eng_text: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Četemu soluos beja ari cyta ciļts, tī beja maori, kuri migrēja nu Jaunzelandis.
eng_text: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Personys, kas beja īsaisteitys vairuokus godu dasmytus, paleidzēja myusim nūviertēt myusu stypruos pusis i aizaraušonuos, vīnlaikus gūdeigi nūvārojūt gryuteibys i pat naveiksmis.
eng_text: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Klausūtēs, kai cylvāki doluos ar sovim individualīm, saimis i organizaceju stuostim, mes givom vierteigu īskotu poguotnē i dažuos personeibuos, kas iz lobu voi švaku ītekmejušys organizacejis kuļturu.
eng_text: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Koč ari izpratne par sovu viesturi, nanūzeimej izpratni par kuļturu, tei vysmoz paleidz cylvākim giut izpratni par tū, kur jī atsarūn organizacejis viesturē.
eng_text: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Viertejūt panuokumus i apsazynojūt naveiksmis, individi i vysys īsaisteituos personys dziļuok atkluoj organizacejis vierteibys, miseju i vierzeituojspākus.
eng_text: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Itymā gadejumā, atsacerūt īprīkšejūs uzjiemiejdarbeibys uzvedeibys pīmārus i nu tīm izrītūšūs panuokumus, cylvāki kliva atvārti jaunom puormaiņom i jaunam vītejuos draudzis vierzīņam.
eng_text: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Itaidi veiksmis stuosti mozynuoja bailis nu puormaiņom, vīnlaikus rodūt pozitivys tīksmis iz puormaiņom nuokūtnē.
eng_text: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Konvergenti dūmuošonys modeli ir problemu rysynuošonys pajiemīni, kas apvīnoj vysaidys idejis voi veidus rysynuojuma atrasšonai.
eng_text: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Ituo dzeivis redzīņa uzmaneibys centrā ir dreizums, logika i precizitate, kai ari faktu apzynuošona, asūšuos tehnikys atkuortuota pīlītuošona, informacejis apkūpuošona.
eng_text: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Vyssvareiguokais ituo dzeivis redzīņa faktors – ir tikai vīna pareiza atbiļde. Jius dūmojit tikai par divejom atbiļdem – pareizū voi napareizū.
eng_text: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Itys dūmuošonys veids ir saisteits ar nūteiktu zynuotni voi standarta procedurom.
eng_text: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Cylvākim ar itū dūmuošonys veidu ir logiskuo dūmuošona, jim ir spieja atguoduot modeļus, rysynuot problemys i izstruoduot zynuotniskūs testus.
eng_text: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Cylvāki naapšaubami ir vystalanteiguokuo suga, kod runojom par cytu dūmu laseišonu.
eng_text: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Tys nūzeimej, ka mes varom veiksmeigi paredzēt, kū cyti cylvāki uztver, planavoj, tyc, zyna voi vieluos.
eng_text: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Storp ituom spiejom cīši svareiga ir cytu cylvāku nūdūmu izpratne. Tys ļaun myusim atrysynuot īspejamuos fiziskū darbeibu naskaidreibys.
eng_text: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Pīmāram, ka jius radzātu kaidu izsytam mašynys lūgu, jius vysdreizuok pījimtu, ka jis rauga nūzagt svešinīka mašynu.
eng_text: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Jis byutu juoviertej cytaižuok, ka jis byutu pazaudejs sovys mašynys atslāgys i tei ir juo mašyna, kurā jis rauga īsalauzt.
eng_text: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: MRI pamatā ir fizikys fenomens, kū sauc par kūdūlmagnetiskū rezonansi, kū 1930. godūs atkluoja Felikss Blohs (struodojūt Stenfordys universitatē) i Edvards Pērsels (nu Harvarda universitatis).
eng_text: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Itamā rezonansē magnetiskais lauks i radioviļni līk atomim izdaleit seikus radiosignalus.
eng_text: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: 1970. godā uorsts i pietnīks Reimonds Damadians atkluoja pamatu magnetiskuos rezonansis attālveiduošonys izmontuošonai kai mediciniskuos diagnostikys instrumentu.
eng_text: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Četrus godus vāluok tyka pīškierts patents, kurs beja pasaulī pyrmais MRI jūmā izdūtais patents.
eng_text: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: 1977. godā Dr. Damadians pabeidza pyrmuo "vysa kermiņa" MRI skenera byuvnīceibu, kuru jis sauce par "Navoldamū".
eng_text: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Asinhronuo komunikaceja aicynoj iz laiku puordūmom i reakcejai iz cytim.
eng_text: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Tys ļaun studenti struoduot sovā tempā i kontrolēt vuiceibu informacejis tempu.
eng_text: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Turkluot ir mozuok laika īrūbežuojumu ar elasteiga dorba laika īspejom (Bremers, 1998).
eng_text: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Interneta i globaluo tīmekļa izmontuošona ļaun školānim vysod pīkliut informacejai.
eng_text: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Školāni var ari īsnēgt vaicuojumus pasnīdzejim sevkurā dīnys laikā i sagaideit saprateigi uotrys atbiļdis, navys gaideit leidz nuokušajai tikšonuos reizei.
eng_text: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Postmodernuo pīeja pīduovoj breiveibu nu absolūtuma. Nav vīna pareizuo veida, kai vuicētīs.
eng_text: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Patīseibā - nav vīnys pareizys lītys, kū vuicētīs. Vuiceišonuos nūteik storp apvuicamū i snāgtuom zynuošonom.
eng_text: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Myusu pošreizejuo pīredze ar vysom izdori-pats informativuom prezentacejom, iz vuiceibom baļsteitī televizejis šovi apstyprynoj itū faktu.
eng_text: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Tik daudzi nu myusim skotuos televizejis puorraidi, kas informej myusus par procesu voi pīredzi, kurā mes nikod napīsadalēsim i naizmontuosim ituos zynuošonys.
eng_text: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Mes nikod naremontēsim automašynu, nabyuvēsim stryuklaku sovā pogolmā, nabrauksim iz Peru, kab izpietēt senejuos drupys voi napuorbyuvēsim sābru sātu.
eng_text: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Pasateicūt zamiudiņa optiskū škīdru kabeļu savīnuojumam ar Eiropu i plotjūslu satelitam, Grenlande ir labi savīnuota i 93% īdzeivuotuoji ir pīeja internetam.
eng_text: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Jiusu vīsneicai voi saiminīkim (ja palīkot vīsu nomā voi privatā sātā) vysdreizuok byus WiFi voi personeigais dators ar interneta savīnuojumu, vysuos apdzeivuotuos vītuos ir interneta kopejneica voi kaida vīta ar publiskū WiFi.
eng_text: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

eng_text: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Var dzierdēt, kai tū soka Grenlandis vītejī īdzeivuotuoji, tok svešinīkim juoizavaira tū izmontuot.

eng_text: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Nūzīdzeiba i ļaunpruoteiba pret uorzemnīkim Grenlandē pryncypā nav zynoma. Pat piļsātuos nav "skorbu rajonu".
eng_text: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

eng_text: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Tutanhamona kops (KV62). KV62 varātu byut slovonuokais kops vysā īlejā, vīta, kur Hovards Kārters 1922. godā atkluoja gondreiž naskortu jaunuo karaļa apbedejumu.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Vystik, saleidzynūt ar vairumu cytu karaliskūs kopu, Tutanhamona kops ir knapi apmekliešonys vārts, partū ka ir daudz mozuoks i ar nadaudzom dekoracejom.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Kotrs, kurs gribēs redzēt pīruodejumus par mumejis būjuojumim, kas nūdareiti, raugūt tū izjimt nu škiersta, byus naapmīrynuots, partū ka ir radzama tikai golva i placi.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Kopa puosokainuos boguoteibys tī vaira naatsarūn, tok ir puorvastys iz Egiptis muzeju Kairā.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Apmaklātuojim ar īrūbežuotu laiku bytu lobuok pavadeit tū cytvīt.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Pnomkroma 12 kilometru iz dīnvydrītumim nu Sīemrīepys. Itys templis kolna golā tyka uzcalts 9. godu symta beiguos karaļa Jasovarmana vaļdeišonys laikā.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Tempļa dryumuo atmosfera i skots puori Tonlēsāba azaram padora kuopšonu kolnā tuo vārtu.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Objekta apmekliejumu var ārti apvīnuot ar laivu braucīni iz azaru.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Kab īītu templī, ir napīcīšama Angkorys caurlaide, deļtam naaizmierstit pajimt leidza pasi, kod dūditēs iz Tonlēsābu.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jeruzaleme ir Izraelys golvyspiļsāta i leluokuo piļsāta, koč ari vairums vaļstu i Apvīnuotūs Naceju Organizaceja naatzeist tū par Izraelys golvyspiļsātu.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Senejai piļsātai Jūdejis kolnūs ir aizraunūša viesture, kas aptver tyukstūšim godu.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Piļsāta ir svāta trejom monoteiskom religejom – judaismam, kristīteibai i islamam – i kolpoj kai goreigais, religiskais i kulturys centrs.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Ar sovu religiskū nūzeimeibu i it eipaši daudzajom vacpiļsātys vītom Jeruzaleme ir vīns nu golvonūs turistu golamierķu Izraelā.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jeruzalemei ir daudz viesturisku, arheologisku i kulturys vītu, kai ari dinamiski i puorpiļdeiti īsapierkšonys centri, kopejneicys i restorani.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ekvadora pīprosa, kab Kubys pylsūni pyrma īceļuošonys Ekvadorā caur storptautiskuom lidūstom voi rūbežpunktim sajimtu uzaicynuojuma viestuli.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Taida viestule ir juopadora legala Ekvadorys Uorlītu ministrejā, i tai juoatbylst nūteiktom praseibom.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Ituos praseibys ir izstruoduotys, kab nūdrūsynuotu organizātu migracejis plyusmu storp obom vaļstim.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Kubys pylsūnim, kuri ir ASV zaļuos kartis eipašnīki, juoapmeklej Ekvadorys konsulats, kab sajimtu atbreivuojumu nu ituos praseibys.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Pasei juobyun dereigai vysmoz sešus mienešus piec ceļuojuma datumim. Kab pīruodeitu uzaturiešonys ilgumu, ir napīcīšama divu vierzīņu/puorsasiesšonys bilete.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Ekskursejis ir lātuokys lelom grupom, leidz ar tū, ka asat vīns pats voi ar draugu, raugit satikt cytus cylvākus i izveiduot grupu nu četru leidz sešu cylvāku, kab dabuot lobuoku cenu iz vīnu personu.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Vystik tom navajadzātu byut jiusu ryupem, partū ka turisti bīži teik sajaukti, kab pīpiļdeitu mašynys.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Redzīs, ka tys vaira ir veids, kai apmuoneit cylvākus, līkūt dūmuot, ka jim juomoksoj vaira.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Itys stuovais kolns, kas bīži ir daudzu drupu fotoattālu fons, pasaceļ viers Maču Pikču zīmeļu gola.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Nu apakšys tys izaver drupeit bīdejūšs, i tys ir stuovs i gryuts kuopums, tok vairumam sapruoteigi fiziski sagataveitu cylvāku vajadzātu byut īspiejamam tū izdareit 45 minutuos.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Leluokajā daļā celeņu ir īkluoti akmiņa pakuopīni, i stuovuokūs pūsmūs tārauda trosis nūdrūsynoj atbolsta margys.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Sagaidit, ka jums nabyus elpys, i esit cīši viereigi stuovuokuos daļuos, eipaši, ka ir sļapnys, partū ka apstuokli cīši dreiži var palikt beistami.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Natuoli nu augšys ir nalela ola, kurai juoizīt cauri, tei ir dīzgon zama i vysai šaura.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Galapagu vītys i sovvalis dzeivinīkus vyslobuok ir apsavērt ar laivu, taipat kai Čārlzs Darvins tū izdareja 1835. godā.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Galapagu iudiņūs kursej vaira nakai 60 kruiza kugi, kuru izmārs ir nu 8 leidz 100 pasažeru.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Vairums cylvāku rezervej vītu jau laikus (partū ka sezonys laikā laivys parosti ir pylnys).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Puorbaudit, voi agents, ar kura storpnīceibu jius veicat rezervaceju, ir Galapagu specialists ar lobom zynuošonom par dažaidim kugim.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Tys nūdrūsynuos, ka jiusu eipašuos iņteresis i/voi īrūbežuojumi tiks saskaņuoti ar pīmāruotuokū kugi.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Pyrma spāņu īsarosšonys 16. godu symtā Čīlis zīmeli beja inku pakļauteibā, cikom vītejī araukani (mapuči) apdzeivuoja Čīlis centralū i dīnvydu daļu.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuči beja ari vīna nu pādejūs naatkareigūs Amerikys pamatīdzeivuotuoju grupu, kas natyka piļneibā īkļauti spāniski runojūšūs pakļauteibā leidz pat Čīlis naatkareibai.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Koč ari Čīle naatkareibu pasludynuoja 1810. godā (storp Napaleona karim, kas iz puora godu atstuoja Spāneju bez funkcionejūšys vaļdeibys), izškirūša uzvara puor spānim natyka sasnāgta leidz pat 1818. godam.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Dominikanys republika (spaniski: República Dominicana) ir Karibu jiurys regiona vaļsts, kura aizjam Espanjolys solys austrumu pusi, kū tei dola ari Haiti.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Bez boltūs smiļšu pludmaļu i kolnu ainovu vaļstī atsarūn ari vacuokuo Eiropys piļsāta Amerikys pasauļa daļā, niu tei ir daļa nu Santodomingo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Solu nu suokuma apdzeivuoja Taino i Karibu ciļts. Karibi runuoja aravaku volūdā i īsaroda tī apmāram 10 000 godu p.m.e.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Puora godūs piec eiropīšu pietnīku ībraukšonys spāņu īkaruotuoji īvāruojami samazynuoja Taino populaceju.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Bolstūtīs iz Bartolome de  las Kasasu (Traktats par Indejom), storp 1492. i 1498. godu spāņu īkaruotuoji nūgalynuoja apmāram 100 000 Taino indiaņu.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Itei telpa tyka izcalta kai ātrijs 17. godu symta klūsteram, nu tuo vīneiguo sasaglobuojuse āka ir Templo de San Diego.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Niu tys dorbojās kai centralais laukums, i tymā dīnu i nakti koč kas nūteik.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Duorzu īskaun vairuoki restorani, i piecpušdīnēs i vokorūs tī nūteik bezmoksys koncerti nu centraluos lapenis.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Buču aleja). Divi balkoni, kurus atdola viņ 69 centrimetri, ir vīta senai mīlesteibys legendai.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Par dažim penijim bārni jums izstuosteis itū stuostu.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Bovenys sola ir populars vīnys dīnys voi nedelis nūgalis golamierkis, kas pīduovoj smaiļuošonu, puorguojīņus, veikalus, restoranus i daudz kū cytu.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Itei autentiskuo kūpīna atsarūn Hou leiča natuoli nu Vankūverys, i tai ir vīgli tikt kluot, izmontojūt regularus iudiņa takšus, kas izbrauc nu Granvilys solys Vankuverys centrā.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Tim, kam pateik uora aktivitatis, ir svareigi dūtīs puorguojīnī pa koridoru "Sea to Sky".
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Vistlera (pusūtrys stuņdis braucīņa attuolumā nu Vankuverys) ir duorga, tok labi zynoma 2010. goda zīmys olimpiskūs spēļu deļ.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Zīmā izbaudit dažys nu vyslobuokūs sliepuošonys īspieju Zīmeļamerikā, bet vosorā paraugit autentisku kolnu ritiņbraukšonu.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Atļuovis ir juorezervej īprīkš. Jums juobyut atļuovei palikt pa nakti Sirenā.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena ir vīneiguo reindžeru staceja, kas kluotyn pi kempinga pīduovoj guļamtelpys i korstys maļteitis. La Leona, San Pedrillo i Los Patos pīduovoj tikai kempingu bez ādynuošonys.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Ir īspiejams parka atļuovis sajimt tīši reindžeru stacejā Puerto Himenesā, tok jī napījam kreditkartis.
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Parku dīnasts (MINAE) naizsnādz parka atļuovis vaira nakai vīnu mienesi pyrma paradzātuos īsarasšonys.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol pīduovoj rezerviešonys pakolpuojumu, kas moksoj 30 ASV dolaru voi 10 dolaru par vīnys dīnys caurlaidi; detalis var izzynuot Korkovado lopā.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Kuka Solys ir solu vaļsts, kas ir breivā asociacejā ar Jaunzelandi i atsarūn Polinezejā, Klusuo okeana dīnvydu daļā.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Tys ir arhipelags ar 15 solom, kas izvītuotys okeanā 2,2 miļjonu km2 plateibā.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Solys, kurom ir taida poša laika jūsla kai Havaju solom, reizem teik skaiteitys par "apakšejuom Havaju solom".
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Koč i tuos ir mozuokys, tuos dažim vacuokim apmaklātuojim atguodynoj par Havaju solom pyrma vaļstiskuma bez lelajom turistu vīsneicom i cytys atteisteibys.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Kuka Soluos nav piļsātu, bet tuos sastuov nu 15 dažaidom solom. Golvonuos ir Rarotonga i Aitutaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Myusu dīnuos atteisteitajuos vaļstīs luksusa gultys i reitišku nūdrūsynuošona ir palykuse par sova veida muokslys formu.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Augstuokys kvalitatis pīduovuojumu vydā B&B, prūtams, konkurej puorsvorā ar div golvonajom lītom: gultys vītu i reitiškom.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Attīceigi vyslobuokajuos itaiduos vītuos var atrast vysgreznuokuos gultys vītys, varbyut ar rūkom darynuotu deči voi antiku gultu.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Reitiškuos var byut īkļauti sezonali regiona gordumi voi saiminīka eipašais iedīņs.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Īstuode var byut viesturiska vaca āka ar antikom mebelem, kūptu apleicīni i peldbaseinu.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Īkuopšonai sovā mašynā i braukšonai garā ceļuojumā ir rakstureiga pīviļceiba sovā vīnkuoršeibā.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Atškireibā nu leluoku transportleidzekļu jius, īspiejams, jau esit pazeistams ar braukšonu ar jiusu mašynu i zinit tuos īrūbežuojumus.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Telts ceļšona privateipašumā voi sevkura izmāra piļsātā var vīgli pīsaisteit navālamu viereibu.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Eisumā, sovys mašynys izmontuošona ir lobs veids, kai dūtīs ceļuojumā, bet reši pats par sevi ceļš, kai puorlaist nakti.
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Mašynu kempings ir īspiejams, ka jums ir lels minivens, sporta apvyda mašyna, sedans voi universaļs ar nūlaižamim siedeklim.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Dažom vīsneicom ir montuojums nu tvaika dzeļžaceļu i okeana laineru zalta laikim; pyrma Ūtruo pasauļa kara, 19. godusymtā voi 20. godusymta suokumā.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Ituos vīsneicys beja tuos, kuruos palyka tuo laika boguotī i slovanī, i bīži tamuos beja loba ādynuošona i naktsdzeive.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Vacmūdeigi pīdarumi, jaunuokūs ierteibu tryukums i zynoma graciozitate ir daļa nu tūs rakstura.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Lai ari parosti tuos ir privateipašums, tuos reizem izmytynoj gastejūšūs vaļstu vadeituojus i cytys augstuos omotpersonys.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Ceļuotuojs, kuram ir skaudzem naudys, varātu apsvērt liduojumu apleik pasauļam, apsamatūt daudzuos nu itūs vīsneicu.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Vīsmīleibys apmainis teiklys ir organizaceja, kas savīnoj ceļuotuojus ar vītejim piļsātuos, kuruos jī gryb apmeklēt.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Kab pīsavīnuotu itaidam teiklam, parosti ir tik juoaizpylda tīšsaistis veidlopa; lai ari daži teikli pīduovoj voi pīprosa papyldu verifikaceju.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Piec tam teik nūdrūsynuots daīmamūs uzjāmuoju saroksts drukuotā formatā i/voi tīšsaistē, šaļtim ar cytu ceļuotuoju atsaucem i atsauksmem.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Koučserfings ir rodīs 2004. goda janvarī piec tam, kod programātuojs Keisijs Fentons atroda lātu liduojumu iz Islandi, tok jam nabeja kur tī palikt.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Jis nūsyuteja e-postu vītejuos universitatis studentim i sajēme miļzeigu bezmoksys izmytynuošonys pīduovuojumu skaitu.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Hosteli puorsvorā ir paradzāti jaunīšim – tipisks gosts ir divdesmitgadnīks –, tok bīži tī var atrast ari vacuokus ceļuotuojus.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Saimis ar bārnim ir rata paruodeiba, tok dažūs hosteļūs jī ir atļauti privatuos ustobuos.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Pekinys piļsāta Kīnā byus 2022. goda zīmys olimpiskūs spieļu reikuotuojpiļsāta, kas padareis tū par pyrmū piļsātu, kas uzjāmuse i vosorys, i zīmys olimpiskuos spēlis.
